agencies.name: Vietnam Environment Administration (VEA)
agencies.role: Issued the technical guidance for calculating the Vietnam Air Quality Index (VN_AQI).

nationalIndex.name: Vietnam Air Quality Index (VN_AQI)
nationalIndex.description: Set by VEA Decision 1459/QD-TCMT of 12 November 2019, replacing Decision 878. Uses O3, PM2.5, PM10, CO, SO2 and NO2, with hourly and daily values and six bands: Good, Average, Poor, Bad, Very bad and Harmful.

monitoring.text: ASMC reported moderate transboundary haze over southern Vietnam in mid-September 2026, according to Bernama.

seasonalPattern.text: In March 2025 satellite data showed extensive fire activity across Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam, Malay Mail reported.

policy.text: VEA Decision 1459/QD-TCMT introduced the current method for calculating VN_AQI.

openQuestions: Public data access (portals, APIs, licences) for VN_AQI has not been checked.
Health guidance linked to VN_AQI bands has not been sourced.
How often southern Vietnam is affected by transboundary haze from the south of the region is not established.
